explained.summary: The Spartans, at their public shows, gave visitors the seats in the shade and sat wherever they could themselves. Marcus records it as a small picture of good manners and self-discipline: look after guests first and don’t fuss over your own comfort.
explained.today: The modern version is giving the visitor the good chair, letting the new colleague take the desk by the window, or taking the bumpy middle seat on a car trip without making a thing of it.
